cues.en: Mike: Now I'd like to walk through an example of a multiple regression.
cues.zh: Mike：現在帶你看一個多元迴歸的例子。

cues.en: You will see that although the basic principles are the same as with a simple regression, things can start getting a little bit more complicated.
cues.zh: 雖然基本原理與簡單迴歸相同，但事情可能開始更複雜。

cues.en: So we're gonna need to think a little bit more about the visualization and about the interpretation of individual beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 需要更仔細思考視覺化，以及個別 beta 係數的解讀。

cues.en: We're also gonna start introducing interaction terms.
cues.zh: 也會開始引入交互作用項。

cues.en: So, you learned what a simple regression means.
cues.zh: 已經學過簡單迴歸的意思。

cues.en: It means a regression where you have two parameters, the intercept and the independent variable.
cues.zh: 就是有兩個參數：截距與自變數。

cues.en: So you might guess that a multiple regression means you have multiple parameters, multiple independent variables.
cues.zh: 你可能猜得到，多元迴歸就是有多個參數、多個自變數。

cues.en: It's really that simple.
cues.zh: 就這麼簡單。

cues.en: So, in fact, you've already seen an example of a multiple regression, although I didn't call it a multiple regression at that time.
cues.zh: 其實已經看過多元迴歸的例子，只是當時沒有這樣稱呼。

cues.en: So here we have three regressors, so four parameters in total, and this is a multiple regression.
cues.zh: 這裡有三個迴歸變數，總共四個參數，就是多元迴歸。

cues.en: Now, in this video I'm going to give you another example.
cues.zh: 這支影片再舉另一個例子。

cues.en: Fake data of course.
cues.zh: 當然是假資料。

cues.en: Do students' grades on a stats exam depend on the amount of time they slept, the number of hours they studied,
cues.zh: 學生統計考試的成績，是否取決於睡眠時間、讀書時數，

cues.en: and also, in this case, we are going to look at the interaction between them.
cues.zh: 以及這裡要研究的，兩者之間的交互作用？

cues.en: So here is our equation.
cues.zh: 這是方程式。

cues.en: We have the observed data Y equals the intercept plus beta one times sleep, plus beta two times number of hours studied,
cues.zh: 觀察資料 Y 等於截距，加 beta1 乘睡眠，再加 beta2 乘讀書時數，

cues.en: plus, and here's where we get the interaction term, the interaction between sleep and study hours.
cues.zh: 再加上這裡的交互作用項，也就是睡眠與讀書時數的交互作用。

cues.en: So notice that this gets one beta coefficient and the interaction between multiple regressors is literally just their multiplication.
cues.zh: 注意，它有一個 beta 係數，多個迴歸變數的交互作用，確實就是把它們相乘。

cues.en: All we do is we take the number of hours slept times the number of hours studied.
cues.zh: 只要把睡眠時數乘讀書時數。

cues.en: Literally just simple multiplication.
cues.zh: 就是簡單的乘法。

cues.en: That's how you implement an interaction term in a regression.
cues.zh: 這是在迴歸中實作交互作用項的方式。

cues.en: And also notice again that all of the parameters that we are estimating here are all linear.
cues.zh: 再次注意，所有要估計的參數都是線性的。

cues.en: We're not squaring any parameters.
cues.zh: 沒有把任何參數平方。

cues.en: You could square hours here.
cues.zh: 這裡的時數可以平方。

cues.en: So we could say beta two times the number of study hours squared.
cues.zh: 可以寫 beta2 乘讀書時數的平方。

cues.en: What would that mean?
cues.zh: 那代表什麼？

cues.en: What would it mean if we ran the same model but squared hours studied?
cues.zh: 相同模型，如果把讀書時數平方，代表什麼？

cues.en: Well that would mean that we are growing out the importance of hours with more time.
cues.zh: 表示時間愈多，時數的重要性增加得愈快。

cues.en: So that would be, the interpretation would be that the more time you spend studying, the bigger the benefit.
cues.zh: 也就是讀書愈久，帶來的好處愈大。

cues.en: So we're allowed to square hours, but we're not allowed to square beta two here.
cues.zh: 所以可以把時數平方，但不能把 beta2 平方。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So, and we did this, so I collected these imaginary data were in a classroom with 30 students.
cues.zh: 我在有 30 位學生的教室中，收集了這些想像資料。

cues.en: So there was 30 students and I asked them how much they slept and how much they studied before the stats exam.
cues.zh: 詢問 30 位學生，在統計考試之前睡多久、讀多久。

cues.en: So that's what we're trying to predict here.
cues.zh: 這就是要預測的。

cues.en: Okay, so here I have the regression table.
cues.zh: 這是迴歸表。

cues.en: So, again, the raw data are made up.
cues.zh: 原始資料同樣是編的。

cues.en: I just came up with these numbers.
cues.zh: 數字是我想出來的。

cues.en: But I really did run the regression, and these are the actual numbers from the regression.
cues.zh: 但確實執行迴歸，所以這些是迴歸真正的結果。

cues.en: So we have a regression table which looks a little bit similar to the ANOVA tables that you learned about previously.
cues.zh: 迴歸表與先前學過的 ANOVA 表有點相似。

cues.en: So we have the intercept here, which is also sometimes called the constant.
cues.zh: 這裡是截距，有時也稱為常數。

cues.en: And then we have our two main independent variables, the study hours and the sleep hours.
cues.zh: 接著是兩個主要自變數，讀書時數與睡眠時數。

cues.en: And then we have the interaction, which is the study by sleep.
cues.zh: 再來是讀書乘睡眠的交互作用。

cues.en: So these are the raw beta coefficients, their standard errors, and these are the T-values.
cues.zh: 這些是原始 beta 係數、其標準誤，以及 t 值。

cues.en: And these are the P-values.
cues.zh: 這些是 P 值。

cues.en: So I would like you to pause the video and compute the degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 希望你暫停影片，計算自由度。

cues.en: How many degrees of freedom do we have for the T-statistic associated with these beta coefficients?
cues.zh: 與這些 beta 係數對應的 t 統計量，有多少自由度？

cues.en: Did you get it?
cues.zh: 算出來了嗎？

cues.en: You had to refer back to the previous video.
cues.zh: 可能需要回頭參考先前影片。

cues.en: So the answer turns out to be 26.
cues.zh: 答案是 26。

cues.en: And the reason is that the degrees of freedom for these beta coefficients is computed as N minus K, where N is the number of data points,
cues.zh: 原因是，beta 係數的自由度為 N 減 K，N 是資料點數，

cues.en: so in this case the number of students that I sampled, and K is the total number of parameters.
cues.zh: 這裡就是抽樣學生數，K 是參數總數。

cues.en: And again, you have to be mindful.
cues.zh: 同樣，必須注意。

cues.en: So when I discussed, this was actually not the previous video, it was the video on evaluating regression models.
cues.zh: 先前討論時，其實不是上一支影片，而是評估迴歸模型的那支。

cues.en: K here refers to the total number of parameters that are estimated in the data, which is not the same thing as the total number of independent variables.
cues.zh: K 是資料中估計的參數總數，不等於自變數總數。

cues.en: So the number of independent variables, depending on how you'd look at this, it's either two or three, but the total number of parameters is actually four.
cues.zh: 自變數依看法，可能算兩個或三個，但參數總數確實是四個。

cues.en: And we can read that off pretty simply just by looking at this equation.
cues.zh: 直接看方程式，就很容易讀出。

cues.en: So the K parameter for this model is the number of beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 模型的 K 參數，就是 beta 係數數量。

cues.en: So in that case it's four.
cues.zh: 所以這裡是四個。

cues.en: Alright, so it turns out that these three are significant.
cues.zh: 這三項顯著。

cues.en: Again, this constant is not something we really care about.
cues.zh: 同樣，常數不是很關心的部分。

cues.en: This tells us that the average exam score when holding all the other variables constant when set to zero is somewhere above zero.
cues.zh: 只是告訴我們，其他變數固定為 0 時，平均考試分數在 0 以上。

cues.en: So people are scoring higher than zero on the exam.
cues.zh: 所以考試分數高於 0。

cues.en: So this is not a terribly interesting intercept term here.
cues.zh: 這個截距不太有趣。

cues.en: Okay, so then let's see.
cues.zh: 接著看看。

cues.en: So the two interesting IVs are significant sleep hours.
cues.zh: 兩個有趣的自變數顯著，睡眠時數，

cues.en: It is not significant on its own, but it's pretty interesting to see that the effect of sleep hours per se is not significant.
cues.zh: 它本身不顯著，但有趣的是，睡眠時數本身的效果不顯著。

cues.en: But sleep somehow is important because it interacts with the number of study hours.
cues.zh: 睡眠仍以某種方式很重要，因為與讀書時數有交互作用。

cues.en: Again, this is very similar to how in an ANOVA where we can have a non-significant main effect, but a significant interaction.
cues.zh: 與 ANOVA 很類似，可以有不顯著主效應，但有顯著交互作用。

cues.en: Okay, so this tells us that there is a main effect of study and more study means higher score.
cues.zh: 這告訴我們，有讀書主效應，讀愈多，分數愈高。

cues.en: That's intuitive, but we also get that from looking at the sign of the beta coefficient.
cues.zh: 很直覺，也能從 beta 係數的正負號看出。

cues.en: So study hours goes up and exam scores go up.
cues.zh: 讀書時數增加，考試分數增加。

cues.en: No main effect of hours slept and there is a significant interaction.
cues.zh: 睡眠時數沒有主效應，但有顯著交互作用。

cues.en: Now how do we visualize these data?
cues.zh: 如何把資料視覺化？

cues.en: We need to visualize the data to be able to interpret these effects.
cues.zh: 需要視覺化，才能解讀這些效果。

cues.en: In the example with a simple regression it was pretty easy, because we just had two axes, we had one axis for the independent variable, one axis for the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 簡單迴歸很容易，只有兩條軸，一條是自變數，一條是依變數。

cues.en: Here, we actually need three axes.
cues.zh: 這裡其實需要三條軸。

cues.en: So we would have a three-dimensional space where we have the x-axis is the number of hours slept, The y-axis is the number of hours studied,
cues.zh: 三維空間中，X 軸是睡眠時數，Y 軸是讀書時數，

cues.en: and the z-axis would be the exam scores.
cues.zh: Z 軸是考試分數。

cues.en: Now, technically we could plot this in a three-dimensional space, but it gets hard to look at, it gets difficult to visualize.
cues.zh: 技術上可以畫在三維空間，但不容易看，也很難視覺化。

cues.en: So instead, what we do here is we discretize one of the variables.
cues.zh: 因此改成把其中一個變數離散化。

cues.en: So you pick one of the regressors and you discretized it.
cues.zh: 挑一個迴歸變數，離散化。

cues.en: So you bin it into, in this case I picked three.
cues.zh: 分成幾個區間，這裡選三個。

cues.en: Note, three isn't a particularly magic number here, but you want to discretize into a relatively small number of bins, maybe two or three, maybe four,
cues.zh: 三並不是神奇數字，只是要分成相對少量的區間，例如兩個或三個，也許四個，

cues.en: but that can already start getting a bit confusing.
cues.zh: 但那就開始有點混亂。

cues.en: So, you can see what we're doing here.
cues.zh: 可以看到這裡的做法。

cues.en: We are treating this continuous variable, number of hours studied, as if it were an ordinal variable.
cues.zh: 把讀書時數這個連續變數，當成序位變數。

cues.en: So a little bit of study, a medium amount of study, and a lot of study.
cues.zh: 讀一點、中等程度，以及讀很多。

cues.en: Again, this is just for visualization.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這只是為了視覺化。

cues.en: This is not actually how the statistics gets run.
cues.zh: 統計實際上並非這樣執行。

cues.en: So now we can also see that there's no main effect of hours slept.
cues.zh: 現在也看得到，睡眠時數沒有主效應。

cues.en: So when we average over hours studied, when we ignored average studied, that means that we average hours studied.
cues.zh: 對讀書時數平均，也就是忽略讀書時數，

cues.en: That means that we are averaging these three lines together.
cues.zh: 就等於把這三條線平均。

cues.en: And the average of these three lines is gonna be basically a flat line going across like this.
cues.zh: 三條線平均之後，基本上會是這樣一條水平線。

cues.en: So, if you would ignore hours studied, then you would see that there is no relationship between hours slept and exam score because the data would just be basically a flat line
cues.zh: 如果忽略讀書時數，就看不到睡眠時數與考試分數的關係，因為資料基本上是平坦的線，

cues.en: with slope of zero.
cues.zh: 斜率為 0。

cues.en: So that's why this is non-significant.
cues.zh: 所以不顯著。

cues.en: And then we have the significant interaction and now we can interpret this.
cues.zh: 接著有顯著交互作用，現在可以解讀。

cues.en: So basically, if you're studying a lot, then sleeping more really helps you on the exam.
cues.zh: 基本上，讀書很多時，多睡一點對考試非常有幫助。

cues.en: And if you're studying a moderate amount, it helps you a little bit.
cues.zh: 讀書中等時，稍微有幫助。

cues.en: And if you only study a little bit, then sleep is actually hurting you.
cues.zh: 如果只讀一點，睡眠反而有害。

cues.en: It's actually making you do worse.
cues.zh: 反而讓表現更差。

cues.en: (laughs) All right?
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Again, you know, these are just made up numbers to make the example work out like this.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這只是為了讓例子如此呈現，而編出的數字。

cues.en: You'll see these numbers in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片會看到這些數字。

cues.en: So you know, don't take this to heart.
cues.zh: 所以不要太當真。

cues.en: I mean, it is good to get enough sleep and it is good to study, but, you know, I don't know what's going on with this thing.
cues.zh: 睡足與讀書都很好，但這裡究竟怎麼回事，我也不知道。

cues.en: Okay, so now you have a better sense of multiple regression, you know how to create an intercept term for multiple IVs, and you know how to visualize results.
cues.zh: 現在對多元迴歸更有概念，知道如何為多個自變數建立截距項，也知道如何視覺化結果。

cues.en: I wanna talk a little bit more about the interaction terms.
cues.zh: 再多談一點交互作用項。

cues.en: Now the thing is that the more complicated your model gets, the more interaction terms, which are also sometimes called higher-order terms
cues.zh: 模型愈複雜，就愈可能納入更多交互作用項，也有時稱為高階項，

cues.en: or higher-order interactions, that you can possibly include.
cues.zh: 或高階交互作用。

cues.en: So let's imagine we have a model with three independent variables, like this.
cues.zh: 假設模型有三個自變數，像這樣。

cues.en: And then we wanna have all of the possible interactions between them.
cues.zh: 想納入全部可能的交互作用。

cues.en: So we have X1 times X2, X1 times X3, X2 times X3, and then we have this ridiculous three-way interaction between X1, X2, and X3.
cues.zh: 有 X1 乘 X2、X1 乘 X3、X2 乘 X3，以及這個誇張的 X1、X2、X3 三向交互作用。

cues.en: So now, we started off with three independent variables, so four parameters, and then we end up with eight parameters.
cues.zh: 一開始三個自變數、四個參數，最後變成八個參數。

cues.en: So the main effects, the two-way interactions and the three-way interactions, and all the corresponding beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 包括主效應、雙向交互作用、三向交互作用，以及對應的全部 beta 係數。

cues.en: Now I would just like to say that, you know, this is mathematically fine.
cues.zh: 我想說，數學上這沒有問題。

cues.en: In terms of the math, there's nothing wrong with constructing a model like this.
cues.zh: 建立這種模型，在數學上完全可以。

cues.en: Of course this would get problematic if you had another term in here for X2 times X1, because X2 times X1 is the same thing as X1 times X2.
cues.zh: 但如果另加 X2 乘 X1 就有問題，因為它與 X1 乘 X2 相同。

cues.en: And then if we had a separate beta coefficient for that, we would be in a situation called, what was that called again?
cues.zh: 再給它另一個 beta 係數，就會出現一種情況，叫什麼來著？

cues.en: It was a kind of a longish term that I introduced several videos ago about least-squares solution.
cues.zh: 就是幾支影片之前，最小平方解那裡介紹的長詞。

cues.en: Right, you know it, good for you.
cues.zh: 對，你知道，很好。

cues.en: It's called multicollinearity.
cues.zh: 叫作多重共線性。

cues.en: So as long as you're not introducing multicollinearity, mathematically this model is totally fine.
cues.zh: 所以只要沒有引入多重共線性，數學上，這個模型完全沒問題。

cues.en: The mathematical gods of statistics will let this pass.
cues.zh: 統計的數學之神會允許通過。

cues.en: But you can imagine that these are starting to get increasingly difficult to interpret.
cues.zh: 但可以想像，這些會愈來愈難解讀。

cues.en: So, yeah, so avoid having too many higher order interaction terms in your model unless it's really important.
cues.zh: 因此，除非真的重要，避免在模型放入太多高階交互作用項。

cues.en: And that's not to say never have interaction terms, of course, but just be mindful that just because you can include an extra term in a model doesn't mean that you should.
cues.zh: 不是說絕不能有交互作用，而是要記得，能加入額外項，不代表就應該加。

cues.en: There's one final point that I want to make in this video, which I already mentioned in the video about the simple regression.
cues.zh: 最後想說一點，簡單迴歸那支影片也提過。

cues.en: And that is the precise interpretation.
cues.zh: 就是精確的解讀。

cues.en: So how exactly do you interpret the beta coefficients in a multiple regression?
cues.zh: 多元迴歸的 beta 係數，究竟該如何解讀？

cues.en: Or this should actually say a regression, because the same applies to a simple regression.
cues.zh: 或者應該只寫迴歸，因為簡單迴歸也相同。

cues.en: So, what we do when interpreting this beta coefficient is we isolate this one coefficient and we ask what is the effect of a unit change,
cues.zh: 解讀 beta 係數時，單獨看這個係數，問 H 每改變一個單位，

cues.en: so a change of one, whatever the scale is, a change of one of those units in H on our dependent variable Y.
cues.zh: 不管尺度是什麼，改變一個單位，對依變數 Y 的影響是多少？

cues.en: Now I already discussed this with you in the example of the simple regression.
cues.zh: 簡單迴歸的例子已經討論過。

cues.en: So that's where I said that for every extra one hour of sleep you are going to spend $2.50 cents less on food the next day.
cues.zh: 每多睡一小時，隔天買食物會少花 2 元 50 分。

cues.en: So a unit change in H on the change in Y.
cues.zh: 也就是 H 的單位變化，對 Y 變化的影響。

cues.en: Now the interpretation with a multiple regression is we need to add another statement here, another clause.
cues.zh: 多元迴歸的解讀，需要再加上一句。

cues.en: And that is, when all the other variables are held constant.
cues.zh: 其他所有變數保持固定。

cues.en: So we change H and we fix S, and we fix S over here.
cues.zh: 改變 H，同時固定 S，也固定這裡的 S。

cues.en: Now it gets a little weird, 'cause we have H also in the interaction term.
cues.zh: 這有點奇怪，因為交互作用項裡也有 H。

cues.en: But when we fix the rest of the models, the rest of the model isn't varying, and all we do is shift the model by one unit in H.
cues.zh: 但固定模型其他部分，其餘部分不變，只把 H 平移一個單位。

cues.en: Then the effect on Y is what the beta value tells us.
cues.zh: 那麼，beta 值就告訴我們對 Y 的影響。

cues.en: Alright, so that was another fun video, learning about regression.
cues.zh: 這又是一支有趣的迴歸影片。

cues.en: I talked about multiple regression with another example, and I hope you feel that you're starting to get an even firmer grasp on regression, how it works and how to interpret it.
cues.zh: 用另一個例子介紹多元迴歸，希望你更扎實掌握迴歸是什麼、如何運作與解讀。

cues.en: And what I'd also focused on here was how to visualize a multiple regression output.
cues.zh: 這裡另一個重點，是如何把多元迴歸輸出視覺化。
